# Green Ghost 🌿👻

> The Best Degen Weed Shop in Thailand. Premium organic cannabis, fast and discreet delivery.

## Summary
Green Ghost is a premier cannabis dispensary in Thailand, offering high-quality organic strains, edibles, and accessories. We serve customers in Bangkok, Phuket, Pattaya, and beyond with fast, discreet delivery. We also feature a unique Green Ghost Degen NFT collection providing exclusive discounts and benefits.

## Team & Expertise
Our team consists of cannabis connoisseurs and cultivation experts with years of experience selecting only the finest premium buds. We specialize in organic high-THC strains in Thailand and premium CBD products for the French market. We take pride in our rigorous quality control and deep understanding of cannabinoid profiles.

## Detailed Delivery Zones
We offer express delivery across Thailand, with specialized local service in these key areas:
- **Rawai**: Local Phuket delivery in under 60 minutes.
- **Karon**: Express cannabis delivery for the south-west coast of Phuket.
- **Phuket Town**: Same-day delivery across the heart of the island.
- **Bangkok**: Next-day and express delivery for the capital's top quality cannabis.

## FAQ
- **How fast is delivery?**: In Phuket (Rawai/Karon), delivery is usually under 60 minutes. For Bangkok and other Thailand provinces, we offer express shipping (1-2 days).
- **Is your cannabis organic?**: Yes, we prioritize organic cultivation methods and select strains grown without harmful pesticides to ensure the cleanest experience.
- **Is Green Ghost legal?**: We operate in full compliance with Thai cannabis regulations, ensuring all products are sold legally and safely within the framework.
